rows.disposition: The action is played end to end and the dismissal and withholding fix is real. tellFails runs after evaluate/setStanding at both call sites (school.ts:3468, :3473), and both dismissal journeys assert the order and the bare notice. But the notice, the guide line and the rowText still promise the year's end after any earlier repeat, where the nine-semester rule refuses it. The repeatedYears clause in tellFails also has no test that isolates it any more.
problems: src/engine/systems/courserecord.ts:140 tellFails `repeatable` excludes only the year itself being in repeatedYears. repeatRefusal (leave.ts:867) also refuses past nine semesters. After any granted repeat that is every later year: withRepeat (leave.ts:841) gives 6 enrolled + 2 + 2 = 10 for a year-2 spring after a year-1 repeat, and 8 + 2 + 0 = 10 for year 3. scope-school.test.ts:676 says this itself: 'one repeat is the most the nine allow, which makes eight'. So a Fail in year 2 or 3 after a repeat, at an evaluation that doesn't end the School (for example good to concern, or concern to warning), is still told 'at the year's end you can ask to repeat the year', which 'Repeating would make 10 semesters…' then refuses. In the last year, offerRepeat keeps the student on because the additional term is open (school.ts:2900), so the Fail's notice offers a repeat while 'Your Degree Isn't Complete', at the same instant, offers only the additional term. This is the same over-promise the fix closed for dismissals. It is found by reading the code, not played. The fix is to test for any granted repeat ((repeatedYears ?? []).length > 0) or for withRepeat > maxSemesters, not for this year's.

src/engine/systems/courserecord.ts:255 (Permanent Incomplete `repeated`) has the same narrow test. A Permanent Incomplete in year 2 or 3 after a year-1 repeat, not awaiting the degree, is still told to ask to repeat the year.

src/engine/systems/courserecord.ts:128-136 (the tellFails comment: 'offered only where a repeat can still be asked'), src/engine/content/guide/school.ts:594 ('only where that can still be asked: ... nor in a year already repeated'; 'A Permanent Incomplete's notice offers it on the same terms') and the row's rowText.downstream all claim more than the code does, for the reason above. The house standard counts a false guide line as part of the change.
